summary.text: Cara Jacob is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Zac Haines.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Cincinnati neurologist.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Cara Jacob said she is a neurologist in Cincinnati and a mother of two.
She listed public education funding, healthcare access and affordability, and tax reform as her key campaign messages.
